contribution_summary: 首次将单参数 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（SKAN）用于漂移动理方程（DKE）代理建模，为托卡马克新经典环形黏滞力矩（NTV）实现快速计算：独立DKE求解时间从35.85 s压缩至3.74 s（9.6×加速），与NTVTOK框架整体耦合后从38.24 s压缩至5.58 s（6.9×加速）。
method_summary: 基于 EAST 超导托卡马克实验参数生成第一性原理 DKE 仿真数据集；SKAN 模块化专家网络架构；与 NTVTOK NTV 建模框架紧密集成，相比 MLP/KAN/神经算子基线在整体预测精度上最优。
title: DKEKAN: A single-parameterized KAN surrogate for Drift Kinetic Equation Toward Fast Neoclassical Toroidal Viscosity Torque Modeling in Tokamaks

author_statement: Shaoqian Zhou, Ling Guo, Xuhui Meng et al.（Huazhong University of Science and Technology / Shanghai Normal University）
contribution_summary: 提出Flow-ABI框架，由两部分组成：(1)泛函先验模型——通过流匹配从历史数据和物理知识中学习表达性泛函先验；(2)集合条件泛函后验采样器——将新观测集直接映射为后验分布，无需针对每个新观测集重新运行推断（摊销推断），支持实时监测和数字孪生。
method_summary: 流匹配（Flow Matching）+ 泛函先验建模 + 集合条件后验采样；摊销贝叶斯推断；覆盖回归与PDE逆问题两类场景
title: Flow-based generative models for amortized Bayesian inference in regression and inverse PDE problems

author_statement: P. Shi, J. Yin, S. Tierney, J. Gao（University of Sydney）
contribution_summary: 标准FNO因截断高频模式而存在系统性谱偏置。**SirenFNO** 引入 SIREN（正弦表示网络）对傅里叶核进行逐模式参数化，以常数且分辨率无关的参数量学习全网格谱，彻底消除频率截断，并通过泛函张量分解提升参数效率。
method_summary: SIREN隐式神经表示学习全频谱内核，参数量不随分辨率增长；泛函Tucker/CP分解压缩SIREN参数；在多类PDE基准上超越标准FNO，在高频振荡场景增益最显著。
title: SirenFNO: Efficient and Full Frequency Learning of Fourier Neural Operators

author_statement: Handi Zhang, Adrienne M. Propp, Brooks Kinch, Houman Owhadi, Nathaniel Trask et al.（University of Pennsylvania / Stanford University / California Institute of Technology）
contribution_summary: 构建数据驱动降阶模型，同时实现物理守恒结构保持与可处理不确定性量化。外微分形式将物理守恒结构转化为拓扑结构，再以此构建通量关系的Gaussian Process表示，推导出具有RKHS后验误差界的Dirichlet-to-Neumann映射，并用轻量Transformer选取结构相容的H(div)-L²有限元子空间。
method_summary: 有限元外微积分（FEEC）+ Gaussian Process（GP）+ 轻量Transformer子空间选择；闭合形式RKHS后验UQ；DOE ASCR资助（DE-SC0024563/DE-SC0023163）；Penn/Caltech/Stanford团队
title: Structure-Preserving Neural Surrogates with Tractable Uncertainty Quantification

author_statement: K. Rafiq, A. G. Nair（2026年6月10日）
contribution_summary: 潜在扩散/流匹配方法在湍流生成中系统性地低估耗散区能谱幅度（MSE-VAE压缩后深耗散区谱功率仅保留25%）。本文提出 **谱正则化压缩阶段**：以区域加权对数谱目标训练VAE，将无条件生成中的深耗散区保留谱功率从20%提升至79%，重构从25%提升至94%，在Re_f≈2250的256²DNS数据集上验证。
method_summary: 将VAE重构损失从像素空间MSE替换为频域分区加权log-谱目标，针对高频区间单独加权；VAE+流匹配框架整体保持，仅训练目标函数改变；评估指标涵盖能量谱、间歇性统计和真实度/多样性权衡。
title: Spectrally Regularized Latent Flow Matching for Turbulence Generation

author_statement: M. Bamdad, M. S. Eshaghi, T. Rabczuk（Bauhaus-Universität Weimar）
contribution_summary: 提出 **HAMNO**，一种融合局部卷积表示、全局谱算子与层级编码-解码结构的神经算子架构，核心是数据依赖的门控机制，自适应在每个空间位置平衡局部与全局信息。物理信息版本 PI-HAMNO 采用强/弱形式物理约束多目标损失。
method_summary: 局部分支（CNN）捕获细尺度特征，全局分支（谱算子）捕获长程依赖；可学习门控权重依据输入场自适应分配局部/全局比例；在Allen-Cahn、Cahn-Hilliard、Swift-Hohenberg方程的长时程展开、域外初始条件、数据稀缺场景下验证，超越标准神经算子基线。
title: HAMNO: A Hierarchical Adaptive Multi-scale Neural Operator with Physics-Informed Learning for Dynamical Systems

author_statement: Minghui Yang, Ling Guo, Liu Yang et al.（Shanghai Normal University / National University of Singapore）
contribution_summary: 受 LLM "harness engineering" 启发，提出 Chain of Operators（CHOP）框架：在不更新参数的前提下，将冻结的 ICON 模型与显式初等变换串联成算子链，显著提升分布外（OOD）算子任务的推理精度。
method_summary: 链中每个算子步骤保持可解释、闭式；在标量守恒律与平均场控制问题上验证，一个 PDE 族上构造的算子链可迁移到不同 PDE 族，提示跨任务共享机制的存在。
research_relation: 对应 TAXONOMY 中"上下文自适应、测试时适配"关键词，为已训练好的基座模型提供无需微调的测试时组合式适配路径，是基座模型下游落地的低成本方案。
title: Harness In-Context Operator Learning with Chain of Operators

author_statement: Ehsan Roohi et al.（University of Massachusetts Amherst）
contribution_summary: 从理论上证明**动理学正激波神经闭合存在本征可观测性缺陷**：仅依赖热流方程的数据残差无法唯一确定BGK方程的张量四阶闭合量（R^cl_xx 与标量过余 Δ/3 的混叠）。提出「双通道重构」策略——引入DVM相容标量过余方程作为第二通道，从而无需直接测量R^cl_xx 即可完整恢复四阶闭合张量。
method_summary: 可观测性分析：将正激波中的高阶矩封闭问题形式化为观测空间投影问题；配套的神经激波求解器研究实验性验证了该失效模式——残差一致性训练的BGK求解器能重现宏观剖面和低阶矩，但张量四阶闭合矩的确定性极差；双通道重构：R^cl_xx = S − Δ/3。
title: Closure-channel identifiability and two-channel recovery in monatomic kinetic normal shocks

author_statement: Tyler Mark, Christopher J. McDevitt（University of Florida, Nuclear Engineering Program；补录：2026年6月）
contribution_summary: 首次将**伴随问题公式化**与物理信息神经网络（PINNs）相结合，构建可在任意初始等离子体条件下快速预测逃逸电子（RE）电流、平均能量及能量分布的层级代理模型。
method_summary: Fokker-Planck 伴随方程公式化 + PINN 代理；层级框架先预测宏观量，再高效预测全能量分布；泛化至宽参数范围等离子体条件。
title: Hierarchical Framework of Runaway Electrons using Deep Learning

author_statement: Ehsan Roohi（University of Massachusetts Amherst，机械与工业工程系）
contribution_summary: 首次系统梳理ML在稀薄气体输运多层次应用中的“承诺、陷阱与验证议程”，覆盖方程求解、算子学习、碰撞物理学习、矩封闭、DSMC场代理和气固界面模型六大层次；提出三级验证层次体系（外推测试、噪声鲁棒性、端到端成本核算），为各类ML稀薄气体模型部署给出操作规范。
method_summary: 分类梳理软物理约束（Loss惩罚）与结构保持设计两类方法路线；特别关注非平衡Knudsen数跨区间、DSMC随机标签、尖锐非平衡结构、不确定气固交互、直接实验基准稀缺等现实挑战；综述至2026年6月最新进展。
title: Machine learning for rarefied gas transport in vacuum and micro/nano systems: promise, pitfalls, and a verification agenda

author_statement: Armand de Villeroché et al.（CEREA, École des Ponts ParisTech / Imperial College London）
contribution_summary: 提出通过注意力 logits 中的可分解偏置结合旋转位置编码，使 Transformer 神经算子零样本泛化到远大于训练时的空间域，在PDE基准与工业级3D大气流应用上验证有效。
method_summary: 分解式局部性偏置 + RoPE 嵌入，不改变Transformer主干结构即可获得可控空间支持范围。
research_relation: 为基座模型部署到远超训练分辨率/域尺寸的实际场景提供轻量级、免重训练的解决方案。
title: Zero-shot generalization of transformer neural operators to larger domains

author_statement: Jay Phil Yoo, William Howes, Yashika Ghai, Kazuma Kobayashi, Souvik Chakraborty, Syed Bahauddin Alam et al.（University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign / Oak Ridge National Laboratory）
contribution_summary: 构建跨托卡马克设备泛化的Grad-Shafranov均衡神经算子框架——将几何参数和剖面参数直接映射到极向磁通场；基于Solov'ev家族解析解在8种设备配置上测试多几何预训练策略，发现单设备预训练跨设备迁移效果差，多几何预训练可实现数据高效跨设备适应；系统基准测试5类神经算子架构（FNO/DeepONet等）在4种迁移学习策略下的表现。
method_summary: 域特定神经算子（几何/剖面→极向磁通场） + Solov'ev可控测试平台 + 多几何联合预训练 + 4种迁移策略对比 + 5类算子架构系统测评
title: Towards Data-Efficient Cross-Device Generalization of Grad-Shafranov Equilibria via Transfer Learning Neural Operator

author_statement: Lennon Shikhman（独立研究）
contribution_summary: 提出算子提升（Operator Boosting）框架——逐步在残差场上训练微型神经算子序列并以验证集选择收缩系数，相比单个大模型减少72-95%参数量；在30个数据集-架构对、10类PDE上测试，21/30组合呈现正精度增益，7/10 PDE基准达到Pareto改善（含2D N-S、浅水方程、Darcy流、3D可压缩N-S）。
method_summary: Stagewise残差集成 + 验证集选择收缩系数 + 同族微型算子堆叠（FNO/DeepONet）；无需重新训练大模型即可逐步提升精度
title: Operator Boosting Produces Pareto-Efficient PDE Surrogates

author_statement: Lennon J. Shikhman（机构待查证）
contribution_summary: 构建了针对学习型PDE仿真器的架构无关后验诊断套件，提供了相对状态误差、半群一致性、有限差生成器偏差、能量行为、积分守恒、容许性约束、扰动响应与标度律一致性兲8项诊断指标。关键发现：相对L²误差可维持中等水平甚至改善，同时物理结构诊断显著恶化——揭示了精度指标与物理一致性之间的根本解耦。
method_summary: 在5个PDE基准任务（2D不可压Navier-Stokes、浅水波、活性物质、3D可压Navier-Stokes、3D磁流体力学）上，对FNO、DeepONet、U-Net、ResNet 4类架构的学习代理进行系统性诊断验证；代码已开源，提交至《Computer Physics Communications》。
title: A Diagnostic Software Suite for Auditing Learned PDE Simulators

author_statement: Jiale Linghu, Hao Dong, Yangshuai Wang
contribution_summary: 提出光子量子神经场（Photonic Quantum Neural Field, Photonic QNF）：以多光子Fock空间干涉与光子数测量构建可训练表示层，将空间坐标编码为可训练光学相位，以光子电路本身作为PINN的神经场表示而非固定特征映射；在7类PDE基准（椭圆型、波动方程、非线性色散、逆问题）上验证有效性。
method_summary: Fock空间多光子干涉 → 光子数测量 → PINN解码；坐标→光学相位→干涉测量的端到端可微链路；光子电路参数作为神经场参数联合优化；适用于椭圆、波动、色散和逆PDE。
title: Trainable Photonic Measurement for Physics-Informed PDE Learning

author_statement: Yitian Zhou, Haoxuan Yu, Fan Mo, Chaoning Zhang et al.（UESTC; 中科院软件所；2026年6月）
contribution_summary: TF-SNO 首次将**时频域门控机制**（Gabor 窗自适应通道选择）引入谱神经算子，在时频联合域实现自适应谱分解，解决标准 FNO 等谱算子对非平稳 PDE（局部时变特征）能力不足的瓶颈，在多类非稳态 PDE 基准上超越 FNO/WNO 系列。
method_summary: 时频门控（TFG）模块：Gabor 窗 + 自适应通道选择激活；时频联合域谱分解（局部非平稳特征精确捕获）；扩展至高度非稳态 PDE（非平稳对流-扩散、Navier-Stokes 非定常等）；超越 FNO/WNO 等谱算子系列基线
title: TF-SNO: Time-Frequency Gated Spectral Neural Operators for Learning Non-Stationary Partial Differential Equations

author_statement: William Cook, Sebastiano Bernuzzi（Friedrich-Schiller-Universität Jena）
contribution_summary: **首创**基于神经网络的特殊相对论MHD子网格模型：在3D Kelvin-Helmholtz不稳定性上进行先验/后验测试，低分辨率模拟能精确捕获4倍高分辨率的磁场放大过程，**在线加速比44×**。
method_summary: 神经网络子网格项训练于高分辨率相对论MHD仿真数据；嵌入大涡模拟（LES）框架；先验（a priori）精度验证 + 后验（a posteriori）在线仿真测试。
title: Subgrid Modelling for Relativistic Magnetohydrodynamics with Machine Learning

author_statement: Vasiliy A. Es'kin, Egor V. Ivanov et al.（University of Nizhny Novgorod，俄罗斯）
contribution_summary: 提出基于可微分波导法（Waveguide Method）与波导神经算子（WGNO）的EUV掩膜梯度逆光刻（ILT）框架。将已有的正向WGNO模型作为端到端可微分物理引擎，通过全衍射模型的自动微分还原掩膜吸收层的复介电常数分布，实现在硅片上精确重现目标场型。
method_summary: 利用前期工作（2507.04153 WGNO）作为可微代理，将其嵌入梯度优化循环；支持TaBN、La、U等真实EUV吸收层材料（λ=11.2 nm），验证2D和3D掩膜结构；无需手动正则化调参，直接优化掩膜透过率分布。
title: Gradient-based inverse lithography for EUV masks via the waveguide method and a physics-informed neural operator

author_statement: Haina Jiang et al.（University of Michigan / KAIST AI / Los Alamos National Laboratory）
contribution_summary: 提出Error-Conditioned Neural Solvers（ENS），与将PDE残差作为优化目标（梯度下降/Gauss-Newton）的经典混合方法不同，ENS将残差场直接作为网络在每次迭代的输入，使网络能够"读取"自身误差的空间结构，学习一个迭代校正策略，从根本上规避传统优化器的高计算成本与不稳定性。
method_summary: 神经代理模型 + 残差条件化迭代自校正机制；每步将当前PDE残差场反馈进网络，网络输出对预测的增量更新，形成闭环自我修正，兼顾统计代理的推理速度与迭代求解器的纠错能力，缓解分布外外推失效问题。
title: Error-Conditioned Neural Solvers

author_statement: Meenakshi Krishnan, Pranav Pulijala, Ke Chen, Haizhao Yang, Ramani Duraiswami（University of Maryland；DOE/NERSC 支持）
contribution_summary: GAIA 是首个将域边界与内部场分布编码为几何 token 并通过交叉注意力条件化积分变换层的神经算子框架，单一架构在**任意几何域**上一次性处理正向与逆向 PDE 问题，无需对新几何重新训练或迭代优化。
method_summary: 从域边界及内部场提取几何 token；以交叉注意力将几何特征注入积分变换层；单一前向 pass 同时完成正/逆问题推断；在不规则域基准（Darcy、Navier-Stokes、反导率）上验证。
title: GAIA: Geometry-Adaptive Operator Learning for Forward and Inverse Problems

author_statement: Joseph Webb, Sadok Jerad, Coralia Cartis（University of Oxford, Mathematical Institute；2026年7月2日新作）
contribution_summary: 提出 DSGNAR（Doubly-Sketched Gauss-Newton with Adaptive Ratio）二阶优化框架，专门针对 PINN 训练中长期被忽视的**损失曲面病态条件（ill-conditioning）**问题，在非线性、混沌、多尺度、高维及 Navier-Stokes 等多类基准上大幅超越现有 SOTA 优化器，将双精度下相对 ℓ₂ 误差降至 **3×10⁻¹⁶**（机器精度极限）。
method_summary: 双重草图化（sketched）Gauss-Newton 近似海森矩阵，降低二阶方法的计算与内存开销；自适应比率策略联合控制正则化强度与步长，稳定病态优化轨迹；不依赖特定 PDE 结构，可直接替换任意 PINN 训练流程中的一阶优化器（Adam/L-BFGS）。
title: An Optimisation Framework for the Well-Conditioned Training of Physics-Informed Neural Networks (DSGNAR)

author_statement: Himanshu Pandey et al.（Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore）
contribution_summary: 基于二代小波提升格式（lifting scheme）提出可逆多分辨率神经算子LiNO，直接从数据学习自适应的多分辨率分解，克服傅里叶截断与池化架构中常见的不可逆信息损失；在Allen-Cahn、Darcy、Poisson、可压缩Navier-Stokes、Gray-Scott等基准上全面优于或持平FNO/WNO/UNO/CNO/LNO等主流算子。
method_summary: 将提升变换本身参数化为神经网络并端到端优化，构造上按性保证精确可逆、无需正交约束或谱截断；在5类不同PDE基准上验证通用性。
research_relation: 提出的无损多分辨率算子学习范式可作为基座模型主干的候选表征方式，为解决大规模预训练中信息损失问题提供启发。
title: LiNO: Lifting based multiresolution neural operator

author_statement: Antonina Timoshenko, Maxim Malakhov, Alexander Fedotov, Sergey Rykovanov et al.（MEPhI / JINR / HZDR / Jena）
contribution_summary: 构建首个束流级非线性Compton散射谱神经代理模型，将单电子谱包络NN与粒子级Lorentz变换联合，无需逐粒子轨迹计算即可快速预测宽相空间分布电子束的光子源谱；已与数千宏粒子级轨迹计算对比基准验证。
method_summary: 两阶段框架：第一阶段NN拟合任意激光参数下单电子Compton谱包络NN；第二阶段对束流所有宏粒子执行粒子级Lorentz叠加→束流级谱；训练数据来自参数化量子电动力学（QED）轨迹计算；适用宽激光强度/脉宽参数空间。
title: Beam-Level Nonlinear Compton Spectra via a Neural Network Surrogate Model

author_statement: Maryam Reza, Farbod Faraji et al.（Simon Fraser University / VU Amsterdam）
contribution_summary: 提出基于机器学习的融合等离子体完整场态重建框架，能够从极少数稀疏传感器（仅数个密度探针）重建多个耦合等离子体场量（密度、速度、温度、电场等）的完整空间分布；在高保真动理学仿真数据上验证了对稀疏和随机布局传感器的鲁棒性，为诊断增强、实时状态估计和数据驱动数字孪生提供可行路径。
method_summary: 时序编码器对稀疏传感器历史序列进行时间特征提取，空间解码器将压缩时序表征映射为完整等离子体场；多量耦合联合重建（避免各量独立推断引入的物理不一致性）；在传感器随机缺失和位置扰动下均保持重建精度；可扩展至实时状态估计任务。
title: Machine-Learning-Enabled Full-State Reconstruction of Fusion Plasmas from Minimal Sensor Measurements

author_statement: Zhen Zhang, Theo Käufer, Louise Ronglan, Michael S. Triantafyllou, George Em Karniadakis et al.（MIT / Brown University）
contribution_summary: 提出基于PINN的求解器无关湍流封闭训练范式，RANS残差通过自动微分约束，完全绕过前向求解器迭代成本，无需推导伴随算子；跨多种鸨体几何形状（圆柱、方柱、椭圆等）实现泛化，四种Reynolds应力闭合形式均内嵌Realizability约束。
method_summary: PINN内嵌RANS方程，损失函数为物理残差+边界条件；三类封闭形式——局部映射模型、输運TKE非局域模型、含可学长度尺度模型；训练过程中求解器完全退出，仅对最终封闭进行求解器稳定性检验；Karniadakis组开源代码。
title: Generalizable turbulence closures across bluff-body shapes by PINN-based solver-agnostic training

author_statement: Udaya Maurya, Suman Aich, Indranil Bandyopadhyay, Daniel Raju et al.（Institute for Plasma Research, India）
contribution_summary: 基于100,760例pyIPREQ自由边界Grad-Shafranov合成数据集，系统对比五类DL架构（Dense NN、PCA-ROM、1D CNN、 2D CNN、PINN含GS残差约束）在标量平衡量、安全因1D剖面和泰松磄1D剖面预测上的精度；同时训练逆模型从期望平衡态估计极向场线圈电流，面向实时等离子体控制。
method_summary: 输入为766次ADITYA-U放电的实验约束参数（圆形限制器平顶相）；2D CNN在全局拓扑量预测上最优；PINN通过GS方程残差监督输出2D磁通剖面，物理一致性更好；逆模型为Dense NN，完成闭环控制通路。
title: Deep Learning Models for ADITYA-U MHD Equilibrium

author_statement: Paul Creusy, Benoît-Joseph Gréa, Antoine Briard, Teo Granger et al.（CEA / Université Paris-Saclay）
contribution_summary: 提出将RANS湍流模型嵌入代理PINN框架，用于标定k-ε-b模型系数（参数误差）并识别修正项（结构误差），解决经典RANS模型在Rayleigh-Taylor湍流过渡阶段严重失效的问题；学习到的修正最终被重新表达为模型状态变量上的显式解析式，无需推理阶段调用神经网络。
method_summary: k-ε-b湍流模型嵌套于物理引导PINN代理内，利用直接数值模拟数据同时标定模型系数（参数误差项）和识别缺失物理修正项（结构误差项）；修正结果以流动指示量显式参数化，可直接插入传统求解器。
title: Learning Turbulence Closures with Physics-Informed Neural Networks for the Rayleigh-Taylor Transition to Turbulence

author_statement: Oded Ovadia, Eli Turkel（特拉维夫大学）
contribution_summary: 提出结合线性全局注意力与局部空间混合的 Local Linear Transformer，缓解标准注意力在PDE算子学习中的二次复杂度与局部偏置缺失问题；在弹性、塑性、翼型绕流、管道流、Darcy流等多类PDE基准（含结构化/非结构化网格、有限元/有限体积/有限差分离散）上取得相当或更低的相对L2误差。
method_summary: 全局线性注意力捕获长程依赖，局部空间混合模块显式引入邻域偏置，并融合坐标与几何信息；在匹配的结构化离散上单次训练迭代耗时较 Transolver 降低1.8–2.5倍。
research_relation: 作为通用高效主干架构候选，跨越多种物理场景与离散方式验证了可迁移性与规模化训练效率，可作为基座模型骨干网络的候选组件。
title: LLT: Local Linear Transformer for PDE Operator Learning

abstract: PGD-NO moves geometric encoding to deterministic precomputation and extracts reusable geometry tokens, decoupling feature extraction from solution queries. The resulting neural operator has linear memory scaling and is demonstrated on industrial meshes exceeding ten million nodes.
title: PGD-NO: A Neural Operator with Precomputed Geometry Decomposition for 3D Million-Scale Physics Simulations

author_statement: Rimsha Hameed Syeda, Dustin Kempton, Viacheslav Sadykov, Irina Kitiashvili, Rafal Angryk（Georgia State University / NASA Ames Research Center；已接收 ApJS）
contribution_summary: 针对太阳宁静区3D辐射流体力学（RHD）仿真中计算代价高昂的亚网格湍流动量/能量输运闭合项，系统性开发并比较多种3D卷积神经网络架构（不同激活函数、不同网络深度/宽度设计），构建可替代显式亚网格模型的深度学习代理，论文含18幅图表、8个数据表，对架构选择与训练策略给出详尽消融分析。
method_summary: 以高分辨率3D RHD仿真的速度场/热力学量为训练数据，用3D CNN捕捉局域湍流结构的空间依赖关系，输出亚网格尺度的动量/能量输运闭合项，替代传统显式亚网格湍流模型嵌入RHD求解器。
title: Developing Machine Learning Models of Subgrid Turbulent Transport for Quiet Sun 3D Radiative Hydrodynamic Simulations

author_statement: Aviral Prakash, Marc L. Klasky（Los Alamos National Laboratory）
contribution_summary: 针对参数化非线性守恒律系统的降阶代理建模，指出现有隐空间动力学框架普遍缺乏预测不确定性估计、且无法保证严格满足守恒律这两大缺陷；提出变分隐空间神经场框架，同时解决二者，在1D对流、2D Euler方程、2D浅水方程三个数值算例上验证。
method_summary: 将隐空间参数化为类高斯过程（GP-inspired）代理，通过学习GP后验均值/方差的可扩展代理网络，使不确定性估计对分布内与分布外参数区域均可行；神经解码器可建模非对称、多峰、重尾的解分布；关键创新是通过变分神经场表示高维"解-通量"矢量的时空无散度向量势，从而精确保证非线性守恒律恒成立（而非仅软约束）。
title: Structure-preserving variational neural fields: Uncertainty-quantified reduced-order modeling of nonlinear conservation laws

author_statement: Gabriel Acosta, Francisco Bersetche（Universidad de Buenos Aires / IMAS-CONICET，阿根廷）
contribution_summary: 证明椭圆型PDE的最小二乘"甚弱形式"（very weak formulation）可由低正则性神经网络离散化（只需测试函数取自适当光滑空间），无需自动微分即可求解，且在奇异解、高维等困难场景下表现良好；重点研究了基于阶跃激活函数与一比特量化线性函数的试探函数，天然适配硬件高效实现。
method_summary: 最小二乘甚弱形式 + 低正则性（不可微）神经网络离散化，避开传统PINN依赖的自动微分开销；试探函数采用阶跃/一比特量化线性激活，便于FPGA/专用硬件的低精度高效部署。
title: Neural Very Weak Formulations enabling Hardware-Oriented deep PDE solvers

author_statement: Ameir Shaa, Kyungtak Lim, Long Shan Chan, Claude Guet（Nanyang Technological University, Singapore，新加坡南洋理工大学）
contribution_summary: 针对三维非线性、通量驱动的边界等离子体湍流仿真（基于双流体漂移简化Braginskii模型）计算代价高昂的问题，提出电阻率条件化的Koopman神经算子（KNO）代理模型，在Global Braginskii Solver（GBS）跨低到高电阻率区间的仿真数据上训练；对分离出的密度、电子温度、电势、涡量等物理场分别构建代理模型，在留出电阻率工况上验证短时域统计特征复现能力。
method_summary: 电阻率条件化Koopman神经算子 + 分场（field-wise）独立建模策略，训练数据来自GBS双流体漂移简化Braginskii湍流仿真；评估涵盖单步预测精度、功率谱趋势、压力梯度诊断量，并指出涡量场自回归滚动预测误差累积较快的局限性。
title: Surrogate modeling of drift-reduced Braginskii turbulence with resistivity-conditioned Koopman neural operators

abstract: Adaptive Mamba Neural Operators use Takenaka-Malmquist reproducing-kernel representations for state-space models to learn PDE solution operators across heterogeneous geometries and discretizations.
title: Adaptive Mamba Neural Operators

author_statement: Harish Ramachandran et al.（TU Munich，Nikolaus Adams课题组）
contribution_summary: 构建首个面向激波驱动可压缩多相流的大规模机器学习基准，含2.4TB高保真2D/3D数据，覆盖气泡溃灭、液滴破碎等强非线性界面变形场景；系统评测卷积、谱域、Transformer及预训练PDE基座模型等多种代理模型家族。
method_summary: 2.4TB高保真数值仿真数据集；统一评测协议对比不同架构族（含预训练基座模型）在可压缩性、间断界面、多相耦合下的表现。
research_relation: 为基座模型在强非线性、多相/间断物理场景下的泛化能力提供了专门的高难度评测基础设施，填补了该子领域基准空白。
title: Neptuna: A Comprehensive Machine Learning Framework for Benchmarking Complex Multiphase Flows

author_statement: Guoze Sun et al.（中国人民大学高瓴人工智能学院 / 北京大学）
contribution_summary: 将物理场视为连续函数的有限采样，提出保局部性的空间分块（locality-preserving spatial patch）离散化方式，在从二维 PDE 动力学到工业级三维 CFD 仿真的多样化基准上取得 SOTA 预测性能。
method_summary: 针对物理场区别于语言/图像数据的特性设计 Transformer 主干，采用跨"空间"与"物理状态"维度的分解式注意力（factorized attention），在保留精细空间结构的同时建模多样潜在物理状态；与 Transolver、Transolver-3、LinearNO、GeoTransolver 等基线对比。
research_relation: 作为面向通用 PDE 预测的新型 Transformer 骨干，其跨尺度（2D→工业级3D）的可扩展性验证为基座模型骨干选型提供了参考，但当前工作仍以逐基准训练为主，尚未展现联合多物理预训练证据。
title: Physics Transformer: Tailoring Transformer for General PDE Prediction

author_statement: Ziye Song et al.（南洋理工大学 NTU / A*STAR CFAR）
contribution_summary: 提出无需真值解的无监督 PDE 基座模型微调框架，解决了下游未见 PDE 系统往往缺乏密集标注解数据、难以直接微调基座模型的痛点；并针对标准 LoRA 在多物理量联合微调时学习不均衡的问题，提出 Newton-Schulz 正交化变体 NSLoRA 加以纠正。
method_summary: 先在多种时变 PDE（跨不同空间尺度）上预训练一个邻域注意力（neighborhood attention）Transformer 主干，获得跨异质方程的可迁移表征；下游适配阶段不依赖真值解，而是构造基于 PDE 残差与边界条件的物理目标函数，通过 LoRA 低秩微调到未见方程；NSLoRA 对每个低秩矩阵做 Newton-Schulz 迭代正交化，端到端比 SVD 正交化快 1.38 倍。
research_relation: 直接回应了基座模型落地的核心瓶颈——真实下游场景常常没有密集标注解，该工作把"预训练-微调"范式的适配阶段变为无监督/弱监督，且提出的正交化 PEFT 变体具有架构无关的可迁移性，为基座模型的低成本、低数据下游适配提供了具体可行方案。
title: Unsupervised Adaptation of PDE Foundation Models

author_statement: Nadiia Derevianko et al.
contribution_summary: 提出基于有理神经网络（"unsafe" Padé 激活单元）的解析延拓方法，用于检测并追踪非线性 PDE 解在复平面上的奇点（爆破点、激波、怪波），在非线性热方程有限时间爆破、Burgers 方程激波形成、非线性 Schrödinger 方程怪波三类结构迥异的问题上验证有效。
method_summary: 采用免反向传播的隐层权重计算方案，配合随时间演化的时变权重/偏置跟踪奇点运动轨迹，突破传统 PINN 固定权重架构对时变奇异结构的表征局限。
research_relation: 作为跨三类不同非线性 PDE 机制通用的奇点追踪新架构范式，为基座模型如何处理解的奇异/间断结构（激波、爆破等基座模型常见失效模式）提供了可迁移的新型网络设计思路。
title: Rational Neural Networks for Tracking Complex Singularities of Nonlinear PDEs

author_statement: Petr Badolia et al.（Leonid Obukhov, Dmitry Bylinkin, Aleksandr Beznosikov；机构未在检索摘要中确认）
contribution_summary: 提出Kuramoto神经算子（KNO），受"耦合振子系统的连续极限可描述广泛一类PDE"这一观察启发，用一个由相互作用振子构成的潜在场的演化来表示PDE解算子，而非现有架构普遍采用的固定基表征。在8个多样化PDE基准上，KNO在多数域内（ID）与域外（OOD）任务上排名第一或第二，在波动传播、反应-扩散、平移与非均匀椭圆流问题上表现最突出。
method_summary: 主干为耦合球面振子的潜在场，通过局部耦合与旋转动力学演化来逼近解算子；消融实验显示局部耦合与旋转动力学贡献最大增益，持续性外部激励带来较小的额外提升。区别于FNO类固定谱基/Transformer类全局注意力，KNO的归纳偏置天然适配局部相互作用主导的物理现象。
research_relation: 提出了一种全新的算子主干归纳偏置，与Transformer/神经算子/状态空间模型家族互补，对未来多物理基座模型的主干设计具有启发价值；但本工作本身尚未进行真正意义上的多物理联合预训练或大规模零样本迁移实验，更接近"新架构基准论文"而非"基座模型规模化预训练"论文，因此基座特性得分受限。
title: The Kuramoto Neural Operator: Learning to Solve PDEs via Coupled Oscillator Dynamics

author_statement: Maryam Reza, Farbod Faraji
contribution_summary: 提出在粗网格数值求解器时间推进循环内嵌入学习式误差校正、并从校正后的粗网格历史重建细网格状态的通用框架，在 6 类 1D PDE 系统（对流、扩散、色散、反应、波动）8–16 倍粗化下、1000 步闭环滚动预测中相较基线降低 50–92% 时间平均相对误差。
method_summary: 循环误差校正算子嵌入数值时间步进循环 + 超分辨率重建模块从校正后粗网格状态恢复细网格场，形成"数值-学习"混合闭环。
research_relation: 作为可包裹任意粗网格求解器的通用混合数值-学习校正框架，跨 6 类不同 PDE 动力学验证有效，呼应基座模型与经典数值求解器耦合（混合求解）这一方向的核心命题，为降低基座模型规模化推理成本提供了可行路径。
title: RECAST: A Machine-Learning Framework for Correction and Super-Resolution of Coarse-Grid PDE Solvers

author_statement: Daniel Musekamp et al.（斯图加特大学 University of Stuttgart）
contribution_summary: 针对 PDE 基座模型"预训练后泛化能力强，但模型体量大、推理开销高，难以作为数值求解器的快速代理"这一部署痛点，提出知识蒸馏框架 TREX（Teacher Rollout Extension），将微调后的大型基座教师模型压缩为高效紧凑的学生模型。
method_summary: 以在目标域少量轨迹上微调过的基座模型作为教师；通过教师自回归 rollout 生成长时程合成轨迹（可选周期性注入噪声）来扩充下游稀缺数据，再用扩充后的数据训练轻量学生网络，从而在低数据域完成"能力迁移+模型压缩"两步走。
research_relation: 从模型部署侧补齐了基座模型全生命周期的最后一环——预训练赋予的强泛化能力如何以低推理成本落地为实用代理模型，为基座模型"训练一次、多场景轻量部署"提供了具体的蒸馏范式。
title: Distillation of Foundation Models for Time-dependent PDEs

author_statement: Anuj Kumar et al.（Pasteur Labs & Institute for Simulation Intelligence / Cornell SciAI Center）
contribution_summary: 指出现有网格化神经代理的两大范式——依赖少量潜在token做全局路由的"全局模型"与沿网格边做消息传递的"局部模型"——均无法胜任工业级大规模、复杂几何网格问题；提出统一视角解释二者局限的根源。
method_summary: 证明全局潜token注意力本质是空间低通滤波器，而局部消息传递缺乏跨大规模网格传播信息的全局视野；将二者类比为多重网格法（multigrid）循环的两半——一个修正谱低频端误差，另一个修正高频端误差，并据此提出交替执行潜注意力与消息传递的 Read-Write-Relax（RWR）架构。
research_relation: 为构建能扩展到工业级网格规模（而非玩具基准）的通用PDE基座主干提供了架构设计原则，其"全局-局部信息传播互补"洞见与多重网格理论的联系可迁移至任意基于网格的多物理预训练框架。
title: Read, Write, Relax: Why Neural PDE Surrogates Need Both Global and Local Processing

author_statement: Xiaoyang Xie et al.（Princeton University，PACM / MAE）
contribution_summary: 提出 Inertial Manifold Neural Operator（IMNO），利用耗散型时变PDE长时动力学存在有效低维不变流形这一理论事实，改善神经算子在长时程自回归预测中的物理可解释性、精度与稳定性。
method_summary: 不同于 FNO 等标准神经算子直接在全函数空间上学习演化算子，IMNO 显式建模耗散系统的低维惯性流形结构；并针对平移等变PDE给出 IMNO-SE 变体，通过对称性归纳偏置进一步提升在此类问题上的表现。
research_relation: 低维不变流形先验为基座模型的长时程rollout稳定性问题（基座模型自回归误差累积的核心痛点之一）提供了理论驱动的可迁移解决思路，其对称性变体的设计模式也可推广至更广泛的基座算子架构。
title: Inertial Manifold Neural Operator for Dissipative Time-Dependent Partial Differential Equations

author_statement: Zi Wang et al.（Stanford University）
contribution_summary: 针对能源化工领域微米级迂曲复杂几何中的多物理场 PDE 求解难题，提出 GeoLAMP 框架，在反应流、热对流、弹性三类新建复杂几何多物理基准上均取得最稳定的自回归预测表现。
method_summary: 图表示上的双编码器架构联合捕捉全局拓扑与细粒度几何特征，将真实空间场压缩为紧凑潜表征；潜空间中用带流匹配（flow matching）的因果自注意力 Transformer 建模时序动力学，支持稳定可扩展的分块自回归预测；解码器可在任意点重建高分辨率物理场。
research_relation: 以单一架构统一处理三类不同物理场并在任意点解码，展示了几何感知潜表征应对不规则复杂域的可行性，可为基座模型的跨几何泛化提供借鉴；但目前验证范围局限于微米级迂曲结构这一特定应用场景，尚缺乏跨方程族、跨分辨率的规模化证据。
title: Geometry-aware Latent Autoregressive Generative Model for PDEs in Complex Domains（GeoLAMP）

author_statement: Hanwen Wang, Paris Perdikaris（University of Pennsylvania）
contribution_summary: 从理论上揭示标准坐标网络（PINN 骨干）的神经正切核（NTK）具有平移变异性，导致大坐标幅值的训练点对远处预测产生不当的长程耦合与梯度冲突，是 PINN 难以处理"多区域异构物理"的根本原因；进而证明中心化、紧支撑路由的混合专家（MoE）架构能产生带宽均匀、随距离指数衰减的 NTK，从结构上实现学习的局部化。
method_summary: 提出 Latent-MoE，在共享骨干网络中交替嵌入"域感知"MoE 模块——不同于 FB-PINN / X-PINN 对参数和定义域的刚性划分（导致子域间参数完全独立更新），Latent-MoE 通过路由机制在保留局部化收益的同时维持参数共享与信息流通。
research_relation: 本文对 MoE 路由与 NTK 局部性关系的理论刻画，为基座大模型中如何设计 MoE 架构以适配跨区域/跨物理体系（multi-regime physics）提供了可解释的理论依据，与已收录的"稀疏 MoE 路由消除多物理基座模型负迁移"（2605.15179）等工作形成理论互补，对基座模型的路由架构设计具有较强启发价值。
title: Latent-MoE: Domain-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for PDEs with Multi-Regime Physics

author_statement: Yves Atchade, Debarghya Mukherjee（Boston University）
contribution_summary: 指出基于 PINN 的 PDE 约束反问题参数估计量会继承神经网络非参数解的慢收敛速率，导致有限维参数推断有偏且统计低效；首次给出无需欠光滑化的去偏 PINN 估计框架及其频率派与贝叶斯理论保证。
method_summary: 两步去偏估计程序：先用 PINN 做 PDE 解的非参数估计，再用基于影响函数的偏差校正消除估计量对神经网络扰动的一阶敏感性，无需对神经网络分量欠光滑化即可得到 √n 一致且渐近正态的有限维参数估计；并将框架扩展到贝叶斯设定，用去偏拟似然替换原始似然，证明伯恩斯坦-冯米泽斯定理给出后验以 √n 速率收缩、协方差与频率派估计量渐近一致。
research_relation: 该统计推断理论回应了 AI 求解 PDE 反问题中长期被忽视的有效性问题——PINN/神经算子反问题估计缺乏渐近保证；去偏方法本身与具体方程无关，可迁移到基座模型下游反问题微调/参数推断任务中的不确定性量化，属通用方法论贡献。
title: PDE-constrained inverse problems at the √n rate via debiased physics-informed neural networks

title: Novel DeepONet architecture to predict stresses in elastoplastic structures with variable complex geometries and loads

abstract: I-PINNs use subdomain networks that share parameters but employ different activation functions to model sharp-interface PDEs with discontinuous coefficients and solutions.
title: Interface PINNs (I-PINNs): A physics-informed neural networks framework for interface problems
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering

abstract: ICNO couples spectral- and spatial-domain information for computational mechanics and parametric PDE operator learning.
title: Information-Coupled neural operator for computational mechanics and parametric PDEs
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering

abstract: The method partitions the domain into geodesic subdomains and progressively activates PINN supervision according to physical information flow, avoiding misleading gradients in causally unreachable regions.
title: A flow-aware training strategy for physics-informed neural networks
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering

abstract: TRANSP integrated modeling code paper for interpretive and predictive tokamak plasma analysis.
title: TRANSP integrated modeling code for interpretive and predictive analysis of tokamak plasmas

abstract: GAPI-DeepONet encodes geometry in the branch input and uses a geometry-adaptive conditioning network to modulate trunk features layer by layer. It is evaluated on cylinder flow, NACA airfoil flow and a three-dimensional heat-sink problem under varying geometries.
title: A geometry-adaptive physics-informed operator framework generalized for arbitrary geometries

abstract: A residual-network surrogate predicts time-dependent NLTE absorption and emission spectra, ion populations and plasma states from density, temperature, radiation field and initial ionization distributions.
title: Deep learning surrogate models to solve time-dependent NLTE absorption and emission spectra

abstract: SONets decompose parametric PDE solution operators into learnable sub-operators, improving modular operator learning for parametric PDEs.
title: SONets: Sub-operator learning enhanced neural networks for solving parametric partial differential equations

abstract: f-PICNN combines convolutional architectures with physics-informed residual constraints over space-time domains for PDE solution learning.
title: f-PICNN: a physics-informed convolutional neural network for partial differential equations with space-time domain

abstract: The framework combines finite-volume discretization with graph neural networks to construct a PDE loss and learn parametric PDE solutions without precomputed paired data.
title: Learning to solve PDEs with finite volume-informed neural networks in a data-free approach

abstract: DGenNO uses weak-form physical residuals and deep generative latent-variable modeling for label-free forward and inverse parametric PDE learning with uncertainty representation.
title: DGenNO: a novel physics-aware neural operator for solving forward and inverse PDE problems based on deep, generative probabilistic modeling

abstract: DeepOMamba combines DeepONet with a Mamba state-space temporal model for efficient long-horizon and high-dimensional spatiotemporal PDE operator learning.
title: DeepOMamba: State-space model for spatio-temporal PDE neural operator learning

abstract: A physics-informed finite-element operator-learning approach preserves equilibrium and periodic boundary conditions for multiscale simulations.
title: EquiNO: A physics-informed neural operator for multiscale simulations

abstract: A Lagrange-multiplier optimization formulation builds on scalar-auxiliary-variable energy descent to obtain robust large initial learning rates for neural PDE solvers.
title: A machine learning method for solving PDEs with a robust initial learning rate based on Lagrange multiplier optimization

abstract: HyMeshAI combines CNN-based mesh-density prediction and ANN-based nodal positioning for end-to-end dynamic three-dimensional AMR mesh generation under irregular geometry and variable mesh size.
title: HyMeshAI: Deep learning enabled three-dimensional adaptive mesh generator for high-resolution atmospheric simulations

abstract: A noise-robust multi-index stochastic collocation surrogate is developed for parametric PDE quantities of interest when low-fidelity evaluations contain discretization, tolerance, or transient noise.
title: Noise-robust multi-fidelity surrogate modelling for parametric partial differential equations

abstract: Equation-recast neural operators provide minimal-data extrapolation and are embedded in iterative PDE solvers, including Boltzmann transport tests.
title: MD-PNOP: Equation-recast neural operators for minimal-data extrapolation and PDE solver acceleration

abstract: PGMNO combines linear multistep numerical integration, an implicit backward-differentiation-formula training scheme and structured state space models to improve the accuracy, efficiency and long-term stability of neural operators across diverse time-dependent PDE benchmarks, including resolution-invariant extrapolation.
title: PGMNO: A physics-Guided mamba neural operator framework for partial differential equations

abstract: MPNOT derives a multi-particle attention layer from multi-particle reaction-diffusion dynamical systems to improve local spatial modeling and interpretability in transformer-based neural operators, with evaluations on Burgers, reaction-diffusion, Navier-Stokes and Allen-Cahn equations.
title: Multi-particle neural operator transformer for solving partial differential equations

abstract: SV-PINO uses separation of variables to transform dynamic PDEs into families of lower-dimensional ordinary differential equations in eigenfunction or wavelet spaces, then learns their coefficients with neural operators. The construction targets spectral bias, high-order derivatives, complex boundary conditions and discrete systems without explicit PDE forms.
title: Separated-variable physics informed neural operators for solving dynamic PDEs

abstract: A physics-constrained neural surrogate estimates runaway-electron avalanche growth rates over plasma parameters.
title: A physics-constrained deep learning surrogate model of the runaway electron avalanche growth rate

abstract: A multi-fidelity Bayesian neural operator learns nonlinear stress-strain function maps for spinodal metamaterial design with uncertainty estimates.
title: A multi-fidelity Bayesian neural operator for mechanics of spinodal metamaterial

abstract: GNoME scales graph neural network models and active learning for materials discovery.
title: Scaling deep learning for materials discovery

abstract: NeuralGCM combines a differentiable solver for atmospheric dynamics with machine-learning components for weather and climate prediction.
title: Neural general circulation models for weather and climate

abstract: GenCast is a machine-learning model for probabilistic weather forecasting using generative ensemble prediction.
title: Probabilistic weather forecasting with machine learning

abstract: A review and perspective on neural operators for accelerating scientific simulations and design.
title: Neural operators for accelerating scientific simulations and design

abstract: A deep neural operator framework addresses PDEs whose computational domain or interface is part of the unknown solution.
title: Deep neural operator for free boundary problems

abstract: Local neural operators are extended from trajectory surrogates to equation-free fixed-point, stability and bifurcation analysis.
title: Enabling local neural operators to perform equation-free system-level analysis

abstract: The paper develops principled rules for lifting finite-dimensional neural architectures to function-space operator learners.
title: Principled approaches for extending neural architectures to function spaces for operator learning

abstract: NOEM combines reusable local neural operators with finite-element assembly for scalable multiscale PDE simulation.
title: NOEM: efficient and scalable finite element method enabled by reusable neural operators

abstract: XGBoost models trained on approximately 1500 ICP ignition experiments predict quartz-tube peak temperature and heating rate and quantify the importance of operating parameters.
title: Temperature prediction of high-temperature and high-enthalpy plasma generators based on machine learning

abstract: Review of machine-learning methods for tearing-mode interpretation, onset prediction, avoidance, suppression, and control.
title: A review of machine learning-driven studies of tearing modes in tokamaks

abstract: A spectral modal operator-learning framework decouples spatial and temporal representations to improve high-frequency and nonlinear modal dynamics for unsteady-flow surrogate modeling.
title: Spectral modal operator learning framework with decoupled spatial and temporal representations for unsteady flows

abstract: The Hermite neural operator uses Hermite spectral basis functions to learn PDE solution operators on unbounded domains. Its continuous outputs intrinsically satisfy far-field decay conditions and support stable off-grid inference beyond the training support, with demonstrations on heat and nonlinear Schrodinger equations.
title: Hermite neural operator for solving partial differential equations on unbounded domains

abstract: GraphCast uses graph neural networks for skillful medium-range global weather forecasting.
title: Learning skillful medium-range global weather forecasting

abstract: Finite-element coefficient-map operator learning for parametric elliptic PDEs with convergence analysis.
title: Finite Element Operator Network for Solving Elliptic-Type Parametric PDEs

abstract: This work develops and evaluates physics-informed DeepONets for forward and inverse PDE problems on unknown manifolds represented only by sampled point clouds. It combines diffusion maps or generalized moving least squares with operator learning and embeds the learned forward surrogate in Bayesian MCMC for coefficient inversion.
physical_domains: unknown manifolds represented by point clouds
publisher: Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics
title: Solving Forward and Inverse Partial Differential Equation Problems on Unknown Manifolds via Physics-Informed Neural Operators
training_pdes: linear and semilinear diffusion-type PDEs on manifolds

abstract: Multiscale neural networks are used to approximate low-regularity Green’s functions, with Barron-space analysis showing reduced network size and faster training for fixed-operator PDE solvers.
title: Multiscale Neural Networks for Approximating Green’s Functions

abstract: A neural-network framework combines tearing-and-interconnecting domain-decomposition ideas for scalable PDE solution.
title: Neural Network Tearing and Interconnecting Methods for PDEs

abstract: RINN adds a covariance-driven orthogonalization and preconditioning stage to physics-informed extreme learning machines, reducing initialization sensitivity before least-squares enforcement of PDE constraints.
title: Rank-Inspired Neural Network for Solving Partial Differential Equations

abstract: An unsupervised physics-informed neural operator models optical-fiber light propagation across configurations.
title: Fast and Generalizable Light Field Propagation Modelling in Optical Fiber by Physics-Informed Neural Operator

abstract: Theoretical study of how PDE order affects convergence behavior in physics-informed neural networks.
title: How does PDE order affect the convergence of PINNs?

abstract: Latent PDE modeling method using local neural fields to preserve spatial structure.
title: AROMA: Preserving Spatial Structure for Latent PDE Modeling with Local Neural Fields

abstract: Study of conditional diffusion models for PDE simulations and posterior sampling.
title: On conditional diffusion models for PDE simulations

abstract: Large-scale collection of diverse physics simulations for machine learning, benchmarking and scientific foundation models.
title: The Well: a Large-Scale Collection of Diverse Physics Simulations for Machine Learning

abstract: Mamba-based neural operator with alias-free design for efficient operator learning.
title: Alias-Free Mamba Neural Operator

abstract: Operator learning approach for accurate optical field simulation in complicated photonic devices.
title: PACE: Pacing Operator Learning to Accurate Optical Field Simulation for Complicated Photonic Devices

abstract: PDE-preserved coarse correction network for efficient prediction of spatiotemporal dynamics using high-order numerical schemes, boundary-condition encoding and neural correction.
title: P2C2Net: PDE-Preserved Coarse Correction Network for efficient prediction of spatiotemporal dynamics

abstract: Space-time continuous PDE forecasting with equivariant neural fields.
title: Space-Time Continuous PDE Forecasting using Equivariant Neural Fields

abstract: Generative PDE-solving method under partial observation using diffusion models.
title: DiffusionPDE: Generative PDE-Solving under Partial Observation

title: Hyperbolic Neural Operator

abstract: Geometry-informed neural operator combines local graph kernels and global operator learning for large-scale 3D PDEs on complex geometries.
title: Geometry-informed neural operator for large-scale 3D PDEs

abstract: DeltaPhi reformulates neural PDE solving as residual learning between nearby physical states, providing architecture-agnostic implicit data augmentation and improving data efficiency across regular and irregular domains, architectures and resolutions.
title: DeltaPhi: Physical States Residual Learning for Neural Operators in Data-Limited PDE Solving

abstract: RNO uses the Riesz transform to combine global spectral information with local directional derivatives, improving sensitivity to non-stationary PDE structure and generalization across benchmark PDEs and real-world datasets.
title: Riesz Neural Operator for Solving Partial Differential Equations

abstract: Benchmark suite for evaluating neural PDE solvers across standardized PDE tasks and metrics.
title: PDEArena: A benchmark suite for neural PDE solvers
